content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"他"},{"ref":"m2","surface":"伊"},{"ref":"m3","surface":"趙太爺"},{"ref":"m4","surface":"阿Q"},{"ref":"m5","surface":"吳媽"},{"ref":"m6","surface":"太太"},{"ref":"m7","surface":"老爺"},{"ref":"m8","surface":"我們的少奶奶"}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m4","object_ref":"m3","type":"雇佣","evidence":[{"quote":"這一天，阿Q在趙太爺家裏舂了一天米，喫過晚飯，便坐在廚房裏吸旱煙"}]},{"subject_ref":"m5","object_ref":"m3","type":"雇佣","evidence":[{"quote":"吳媽，是趙太爺家裏唯一的女僕，洗完了碗碟，也就在長凳上坐下了，而且和阿Q談閒天"}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
